scope: Storage-only successor to v1: strict shared prewrite quota and owned immutable deduplication. Same source qualification, feature values and reference algorithms. No predictive experiment or activation.

players.name: players.parquet
players.purpose: Exact source identity only; no PFR-derived participation or snap features

rosters.name: roster_weekly_{season}.parquet
rosters.purpose: Opportunity membership only; ACT/INA is not game participation

license.name: nflverse_LICENSE.md
license.purpose: Hosting license receipt, not a blanket upstream grant

excluded_source_families: NGS/news/weather in this operational source variant

history.prior_filter_rule: Read schedule metadata only. Include a season/week only when every scheduled REG game in that week has kickoff+7days strictly before supplied actual asof. Push exact OR season/week/game_type filters into stats and roster parquet reads BEFORE statistic values are loaded. Keep schedule metadata for identity/future population separately; never scores.
history.source_seasons: Explicit supported input seasons, 2012 through supplied NFL active season; active season may differ from UTC year in January.
history.protected_confirmation: During software/cache acceptance read at most2026Weeks1-5; no2026W8+ outcomes while tuning. Future operational use of earlier weeks is allowed only under this frozen source/training policy after availability/cutoff gates, never hyperparameter selection.
history.participation: Reuse unchanged qualify_history: supported positive physical official event establishes playing; zero-only/missing/ACT/INA rows stay unknown and remain rolling slots. Separate existing supported final-provider DNP grading may be retained.
history.scoring: Signed yardage and supported count zeros preserved; missing fields not zero. Exact website PPR remains blocked without full label contract.
history.publication_times: Known local receipt clocks retained. Historical availability kickoff+7days is an explicit reconstruction assumption, not authenticated upstream publication.
history.participation_probability: Unavailable: this sufficient-positive playing panel has no complete DNP/nonappearance denominator. Emitted forecasts and new reference artifacts must have participation unavailable, not a near-one selected-population probability.

parquet_predicates.week_filter: OR of exact allowed season/week pairs computed from schedule metadata before reading statistical columns

namespaces.isolation: Owned immutable SHA256 blobs with verified hardlink aliases; external legacy originals copied, never linked or modified. V1 frozen namespaces remain read-only.
namespaces.identity: V2 policy+storage/source/routing/shared helper code+original receipts+subset filters/hashes+qualified values bind all new artifacts. Reject v1 artifacts on v2 routes.

operational_routing.source_policy: Explicit --source-policy config/operational-source-policy-v2.json; source/reference versions v2, existing scheduler only; historical v1 replay via Git a8ddbf9e9d1c7360e0942877fa9183533604f091.
operational_routing.weekly_search: No repeat of consumed historical campaign/search. Weekly learning deterministically refreshes only fixed recent/pooled reference parameters on earlier qualified input versions, at most22 supported packages, no new accuracy scoring, no selected.json or default-model promotion. Original research campaign/config stays frozen for historical replay.
operational_routing.failure: Affected new issuance/training abstains with explicit failure; preserve earlier immutable forecasts and continue grading/replay. Never fall back to forbidden legacy loader.
operational_routing.grading: Primary saved Sleeper final/correction contract unchanged. Supplemental NFL cache fallback uses the same permitted source policy; no new snap source reads. Do not rewrite prior corrections.
operational_routing.frozen_records: rec-half source/registration/Weeks7-14 remain separately owned, no recorder/backfill/restart. Original RB protocol and PPR gates unchanged.

cache_acceptance.acceptance: One bounded invocation: same cutoff source/history/query values bitwise equal to accepted v1 parquet frames after attrs removed; identical-asof idempotency and nearby earlier-asof unchanged-body dedup; all writes inside cap, no originals changed. Original cutoff 2026-10-23T11:27:49.536081+00:00 and minus1microsecond; no later/protected reads. Zero model fits/predictions/scores.

budgets.later_reference_runtime: Must separately freeze exact code/input/query versions and a bounded22-package recent/pooled verification before any real reference fitting/inference. Actual hosted run requires accepted code/checks; no website run. This plan alone does not claim activation.
budgets.network_acquisition: No new HTTP in local acceptance. Operational acquisition reuses existing bounded downloader at most3attempts/URL,2threads,512MiBtotal bodies and dailyonce refresh. Wire a hard outer daily/weekly job cap; retain failures.
budgets.technical_repairs: At most one separately registered zero-fit cache acceptance repair within unspent cumulative limits; preserve original failure marker. Import-only capability preflight before consuming invocation.

software_acceptance: No PFR file request/read even if poisoned snap file exists in old cache
Before-stat-read filters and no protected outcome reads
Explicit played-zero/missing/DNP/unknown and signed yard semantics
No legacy selected methods/model cache reuse in policy path
All operational commands and grading failure/retry/idempotency/replay paths use source policy
Training view/code/source hashes bound and frozen input files unchanged
Season rollover Januaryactiveyear vs UTCyear and REG/Post behavior
Single scheduler/resource/retention controls and website unchanged
Exact before-write rejection for body/chunk/atomic peak/concurrent writers and no external hardlink mutation
Every operational write route uses shared managed quota including state/model/private runs/baseline cache/failure paths
Owned immutable same-body aliases share inode while distinct receipts retain true clocks
Frozen v1 helper/code/evidence unchanged; source/history/feature value parity
public_export: Reviewed code/fictional tests/config plus derived aggregate receipts/hashes only; no raw sources/player rows/model weights.
evidence_lane: Software acceptance and current-vintage source reconstruction only; zero new independent-confirmation samples.
publication_note: Storage code/config/fictional tests and derived aggregate acceptance only. No weights/raw/player rows. Separate frozen22 runtime and hosted acceptance still required; no readiness or accuracy claim.

storage.state_root: supplied state directory, all files including preexisting bytes counted; preserve originals
storage.additional_roots: Explicit caller-registered operational run receipts and optional local website-baseline intake cache. All operational write destinations must be registered before use.
storage.accounting: Sum st_size once per unique (device,inode) across registered roots, including control metadata, owned blobs, hardlink aliases, staging, partials, model temporaries, receipts and all supplied state records. Report logical referenced bytes separately; this is unique-file byte accounting, not filesystem block allocation.
storage.concurrency: One canonical cache-owned global flock and persisted root registry; reject conflicting owners, symlinks, escapes and unaccounted external hardlinks. Reserve before every incoming serialized body/chunk and hold lock through publish. Account atomic replacement old+incoming peak.
storage.writes: Exact serialized bytes preflight. Scoped Path.write_bytes/write_text/open(wb) chunk writer and DataFrame parquet/csv capture only registered managed roots; frozen helper bytes unchanged. Scoped state.save/model atomic serializer adapters must use quota primitives including failure/offseason/grade/prefetch paths. Unsupported writable open modes fail closed except known zero-byte locks.
storage.immutability: Published blobs/aliases immutable and hash-verified; no writes through linked inode. Copy external originals into owned store before aliasing; never chmod legacy originals. Mutable unpublished staging may atomically replace via known bytes; retained blobs still count.
storage.retention: No automatic deletion/expiry/GC in this version. Reuse identical body/subset bytes; preserve distinct authentic receipt clocks. All retained/orphan bytes count. If finite cap cannot fit, abstain affected writes; retain existing evidence. No promise infinite vintages fit finite storage.
storage.legacy: Accepted v1 source/feature packet and other frozen caches outside registered roots stay immutable and excluded. Any preexisting files under a supplied registered state/run root are counted, never removed.
storage.derived_state: Existing state.save 200MiB evidence limit remains in addition to global 512MiB; no weakening. Failure metadata also needs capacity; inability to save a marker must surface as an error, never claim persistence.
